analysis: The PR modifies only docs/developer/test.md. The visible changes are documentation wording: line 5 drops the "retained-console" test reference; the patch excerpt also shows a reworded fixture-ownership paragraph near base 958-962 (darkbloom-platform now keeps byte-identical copies of paged_footprint_wire.json and process_memory_wire.json) and a docs-impact sentence near base 1070 that drops "console packaging". The head text supplied covers lines 1-474 and 475-939 (the units end before the changed regions near 958 and 1070), so the patch excerpt, which is also truncated, is the only evidence for those hunks. No code, configuration, cryptographic or authorization behavior changes. The surrounding test guidance still tells readers to use isolated state, avoid production roots and keys, and avoid overwriting running provider state. These match the controls in T-041 (isolated ephemeral caches, no production cache roots), the TB-012 add-on hold tests and the App Attest resumption and logout tests. Those tests use synthetic credentials, and the guidance does not weaken any security gate. The removal of the console mentions is consistent with the ownership rescope in the canonical header (backend and console are out of scope). I found no regression and no invalidated threat assumption. Limitation: the truncated patch means any later hunks past the excerpt (the base ranges 1084-1097 removal) were not directly inspected. They are documentation-only by file type, and there is no evidence they are security-relevant.
